display.purpose: The name in the hero, signage scale, once per page.

headline-terminus.purpose: Contact heading at the end of the line.

headline-plate.purpose: Section h2, always inside a square ink station plate.

title.purpose: h3 for roles, stages, principles, projects, stack rows; 1.125rem to 1.625rem.

lead.purpose: Hero lead and section intros in muted ink.

board-figure.purpose: Departure-board impact numbers in flap cells.

label-mono.purpose: Dates, times, stage numbers, proof figures only.

shadows.name: rider-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifts the moving amber rider above the route band. The only lift in the system.

shadows.name: flap-split
shadows.purpose: Highlight under the split line in each departure-board cell.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The single easing for every transition and keyframe.

motion.name: draw-line
motion.purpose: Hero strip-map band draws once on load.

motion.name: stop-in
motion.value: 0.5s scale 0.4 to 1 with fade, delays 0.15s + 0.25s per station
motion.purpose: Strip-map stations light in order behind the drawing line.

motion.name: here-ring
motion.value: 1.8s scale 1 to 1.7 fade out, 1.6s delay, 3 iterations
motion.purpose: Amber pulse on the current station, then rests.

motion.name: route-fill
motion.value: scaleY(var(--progress)) driven by scroll to mid-viewport
motion.purpose: Route fills solid behind the rider; stops above mid-viewport turn plum.

motion.name: digit-roll
motion.value: reel translateY, 900ms + 160ms per digit, once on 60% visibility
motion.purpose: Departure-board digits roll to value once.

motion.name: nav-bar
motion.purpose: Plum underline bar on hover and active section.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation 0.01ms, no delay, 1 iteration; reel, roundel, project transitions removed; digits not built
motion.purpose: No spatial travel; end states and colour changes remain.

breakpoints.name: hero-where
breakpoints.purpose: Employer and location stack below this.

breakpoints.name: rail
breakpoints.purpose: Route rail 64px appears; strip map horizontal; hero two columns.

breakpoints.name: rows
breakpoints.purpose: Role, stage and stack rows go multi-column.

breakpoints.name: hero-wide
breakpoints.purpose: Wider portrait column, contact two columns.

components.css: .ds-strip { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-strip::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 19px; height: 10px; background: var(--line); transform-origin: left; animation: ds-draw 1.4s var(--ease) both; } .ds-strip a { position: relative; display: grid; justify-items: start; gap: 2px; padding-right: 12px; color: var(--text); text-decoration: none; } .ds-strip a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-roundel { width: 48px; height: 48px; margin-bottom: 14px; border-radius: 50%; border: 9px solid var(--text); background: var(--bg); box-sizing: border-box; transition: transform 0.25s var(--ease), background-color 0.25s; } .ds-strip a:hover .ds-roundel { transform: scale(1.12); background: var(--line-soft); } .ds-st-name { font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-st-time { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-here .ds-roundel { background: var(--here); } .ds-here .ds-st-time { padding: 1px 8px 0; background: var(--here); color: var(--on-here); font-weight: 600; } @keyframes ds-draw { from { transform: scaleX(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-strip::before { animation: none; } .ds-roundel { transition: none; } }

components.css: .ds-route { position: relative; width: 10px; height: 170px; margin-left: 24px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--line) 0 14px, transparent 14px 26px); } .ds-route-fill { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: 50%; background: var(--line); } .ds-stop { position: absolute; left: -12px; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; border: 7px solid var(--text); background: var(--bg); box-sizing: border-box; transition: background-color 0.3s var(--ease); } .ds-passed { background: var(--line); } .ds-rider { position: absolute; top: 72px; left: -8px; width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--here); border: 5px solid var(--text); box-sizing: border-box; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18); }

narrative.overview:
The career is a single transit line and the page is a ride along it. The world is enamel signage: a warm off-white ground, near-black sign ink, and one plum line colour drawn as continuous bands. Amber appears only where the visitor is, or where the career is now. Type is Overpass, a Highway Gothic descendant, set heavy and tight like station signage; Overpass Mono speaks only for figures, dates and times, the way a timetable does.

Density alternates like a line does. Dense stations (the departure board of measured outcomes, the STLC stopping pattern, the career roles) are separated by quiet platforms on the enamel-white plate ground (leadership, stack, credentials). On wide screens a vertical route runs down a left rail through every section: dashed ahead, solid behind, with an amber rider at mid-viewport and a stop at each section head. On phones the rail is dropped and the hero strip map turns vertical, because the gutter would cost the reading measure.

The system is flat and drawn. Depth comes from ink rules, solid plates and colour fields, never from cards floating on shadows. The user ruled out flashy creative-agency effects and the dark neon "AI" look; the dark theme is the same signage at night, not a glow treatment.
keyCharacteristics: One plum line colour, used as bands, rules and fills; amber reserved for "you are here".
One numbered neutral ramp (n-0 to n-9) carries ground, plates, rules and text.
Section titles are square ink station plates; positions on the line are round roundels.
Overpass heavy for signage, Overpass Mono only for figures, dates and times.
Flat surfaces, ink borders, colour-field sections (ink board, plum terminus).
Motion is the line itself: drawn once, filled by scroll, digits rolled once.

rules.name: The One Line Rule
rules.body: Plum is the only hue that draws structure. No second accent, no gradient of plums beyond line, ink and wash.

rules.name: The You-Are-Here Rule
rules.body: Amber marks position only: the current station, the current role, the rider, the terminus. If an amber element does not answer "where am I on the line", it is not amber.

rules.name: The Numbered Ramp Rule
rules.body: Neutrals come from the n-ramp or a themed alias of it (bg, plate, rule, text, text-muted). New greys are added as ramp steps, not inline tints.

rules.name: The Timetable Rule
rules.body: Overpass Mono sets figures, dates and times only. Never a heading, never a sentence.

rules.name: The Heavy Sign Rule
rules.body: Headings run 800 to 900 with negative tracking; nothing between 400 body and 700 is used for headings.

rules.name: The Drawn Not Floated Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate by rule, frame or colour field. Do not lift sections or rows on shadows.

rules.name: The Square Information, Round Position Rule
rules.body: If it names something it is square; if it marks where something is on the line it is round.

dos: Do draw structure in Line Plum only, as bands of 10px (route, strip), 5px (nav bar, principle rules) or 4px (stopping-pattern track).
Do wrap every section h2 in a square ink station plate.
Do keep amber for position: the current station, current role, rider and terminus.
Do set dates, times and figures in Overpass Mono with tabular figures on the board.
Do separate content with ink rules, hairlines and colour fields; keep surfaces flat.
Do alternate dense sections with quiet enamel-white platforms.
Do keep the reduced-motion path: animations collapse to their end state, the reel and roundel transitions are removed, and the board renders its final figures from markup.

Do run motion through the line: the hero band draws over 1.4s, stations light in order at 0.25s steps, the route fills with scroll, digits roll once when the board enters view, all on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
donts: Don't use amber for decoration, emphasis or status unrelated to "where am I".
Don't add a second accent hue or plum tints beyond line, ink and wash.
Don't set headings or prose in Overpass Mono.
Don't lift sections or rows on drop shadows or build card grids with shadows.
Don't use flashy creative-agency effects or a dark neon "AI" look; the dark theme is night signage, not glow.
Don't introduce neutrals outside the numbered ramp and its themed aliases.
Don't use the font's middle-dot glyph as a separator; use the drawn dot.
